base.description: DeepSeek 官方开源 Agent Harness

display.longDescription: DeepSeek Harness 是 DeepSeek 官方开源的 Agent Harness。Kite 固定安装官方 Harness 0.1.1-rc.2，并通过独立维护的完整 ACP 桥接层提供会话创建、列表、恢复、历史加载、流式消息、工具审批、实时模型、推理强度和三种执行权限；MCP、Skill、模型供应商、登录凭据与会话日志仍由 Harness 自己管理。安装时会把 Harness 的会话首次发布从硬链接切换为原子重命名，避开 Android PRoot 的 link2symlink 语义冲突。官方当前提供的 ACP Demo 仅支持新会话，因此不作为 Kite 的运行入口。

agents.name: DeepSeek Harness
agents.description: DeepSeek Harness 完整 ACP 会话

steps.cmd:
set -eu
persistence_js="$install_root/npm-global/lib/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js"
test -f "$persistence_js"
if grep -Fq 'await link(tmp, finalPath);' "$persistence_js"; then
  sed -i 's/import { link, mkdir, mkdtemp, open, readFile, readdir, realpath, rm, stat, truncate }/import { mkdir, mkdtemp, open, readFile, readdir, realpath, rename, rm, stat, truncate }/' "$persistence_js"
  sed -i 's/await link(tmp, finalPath);/await rename(tmp, finalPath);/' "$persistence_js"
fi
grep -Fq 'await rename(tmp, finalPath);' "$persistence_js"
grep -Fq 'realpath, rename, rm' "$persistence_js"

set -eu
acp_root="$install_root/npm-global/lib/node_modules/@openma/deepseek-harness-acp/dist"
for acp_js in "$acp_root/bridge.js" "$acp_root/plugin.js" "$acp_root/server.js"; do
  test -f "$acp_js"
  if grep -Fq 'requireCredential(config.provider)' "$acp_js"; then
    sed -i 's/requireCredential(config.provider)/requireCredential(defaultProvider())/g' "$acp_js"
  fi
  if grep -Fq 'requireCredential(record.provider ?? config.provider)' "$acp_js"; then
    sed -i 's/requireCredential(record.provider ?? config.provider)/requireCredential(routeOf(record).provider)/g' "$acp_js"
  fi
  test "$(grep -Fc 'requireCredential(defaultProvider())' "$acp_js")" -eq 2
  test "$(grep -Fc 'requireCredential(routeOf(record).provider)' "$acp_js")" -eq 2
  ! grep -Fq 'requireCredential(config.provider)' "$acp_js"
  ! grep -Fq 'requireCredential(record.provider ?? config.provider)' "$acp_js"
done

set -eu
mkdir -p "$install_root/bin" "$install_root/user-home/.dsh"
cat > "$install_root/bin/kite-dsh-acp" <<EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eu
export HOME="$install_root/user-home"
export DSH_HOME="$install_root/user-home/.dsh"
dsh_bin="\$(command -v dsh)"
[ -n "\$dsh_bin" ] || { echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=prepare step=deepseek-harness-host reason=dsh-missing' >&2; exit 127; }
export DSH_PATH="\$dsh_bin"
exec dsh-acp "\$@"
EOF
chmod 755 "$install_root/bin/kite-dsh-acp"

verify.cmd: persistence_js="$install_root/npm-global/lib/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js" && grep -Fq 'await rename(tmp, finalPath);' "$persistence_js" && grep -Fq 'realpath, rename, rm' "$persistence_js"

acp_root="$install_root/npm-global/lib/node_modules/@openma/deepseek-harness-acp/dist" && for acp_js in "$acp_root/bridge.js" "$acp_root/plugin.js" "$acp_root/server.js"; do test "$(grep -Fc 'requireCredential(defaultProvider())' "$acp_js")" -eq 2 && test "$(grep -Fc 'requireCredential(routeOf(record).provider)' "$acp_js")" -eq 2 && ! grep -Fq 'requireCredential(config.provider)' "$acp_js" && ! grep -Fq 'requireCredential(record.provider ?? config.provider)' "$acp_js" || exit 1; done
